_instructions: Replace workflow with a ComfyUI export in API format. Replace every binding [node_id,input_key] and output_node_id with actual IDs. Set configured=true only after testing. Duration binding is seconds: map conversion to frame count inside your workflow. reference and character_reference must be distinct scene and actor conditioning nodes. continuation_reference is the final carry frame; condition as a starting image. source_video binds a video loader. Never bind multiple values to the same input. Output must be 24fps and requested duration.
